items.summary: CFO recommendation: preserve containment, admit no new work, and do not make revenue, ROI, contribution-margin, or forecast claims this cycle. September AI usage was 5,531 calls costing $1,002.46, including 234 errors; average AI cost was approximately $0.181 per call. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The $4.92 is aggregate under tracking_id=other and cannot be assigned to a site; the date also does not align to the September AI-cost window. Therefore site revenue, contribution margin, payback, and ROI are unsupported. Fleet-level revenue-to-AI-cost comparison is only a non-comparable reference: $4.92 versus $1,002.46, not a valid return calculation. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because experiment-level AI, infrastructure, labor, and implementation costs are not linked to hypotheses or measured outcomes. Minimum measurement needed is a dated experiment ledger linking site/content/change ID to incremental AI cost, infrastructure cost, implementation effort, attributable commission, orders, shipped items, and measurement window. Do not treat 14,734 impressions, 150 clicks, 1,021 sessions, 17 conversions, proposal counts, or output volume as financial returns. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA work only after capacity clears, using outbound affiliate clicks as the primary metric and revenue as secondary. Keep launch and monetization gates unchanged until attribution and direct-cost evidence exist.

CFO handoff: retain the existing capacity gate. No finance implementation or duplicate telemetry request is justified because current read-only financial and AI telemetry is available; the blocker is missing linkage and cost allocation. If capacity later permits, the minimum report-only finance artifact should be an experiment-level unit-economics ledger, not a new dashboard or production change.
